faqs.q: What cashback does AU Business Cashback Credit Card offer?
faqs.a: AU Business Cashback Credit Card offers 1% cashback on repayment of the total amount due every month. However, this cashback is capped at Rs. 1,000 per month.

faqs.q: What lounge access benefits are available with this card?
faqs.a: Cardholders get 8 complimentary railway lounge visits per year, limited to 2 visits per quarter. Lounge access is available at select railway stations using the VISA or RuPay variant of the card.

faqs.q: What dining benefits come with AU Business Cashback Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card offers up to 30% discount at over 300 partner restaurants across 30 cities under the Silver Spoon Dining Program, making it beneficial for frequent dining and business meals.

faqs.q: Is there any fee waiver on AU Business Cashback Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, the monthly fee of Rs. 99 plus taxes is waived if retail spends on the card exceed Rs. 10,000 in a billing cycle, helping reduce overall card cost.

faqs.q: What fuel benefits does this card offer?
faqs.a: The card offers 1% fuel surcharge waiver on fuel transactions between Rs. 400 and Rs. 5,000, capped at Rs. 200 per month, providing modest savings on regular fuel expenses.
